clause: Arbitrary unit test state in Dom H
evidence_or_owed: Part (a) holds for every unit vector of the form domain, which contains Dom H, with the case of fidelity one stated separately and without reference to a preparation.

clause: Nonnegative conditional excitation scale for any eligible state
evidence_or_owed: The scale Z is defined as the excitation energy of the normalized orthogonal component and shown nonnegative. The text says that it depends on the state, when it is constant, and bounds it by the gap and by the width of a bounded spectrum.

clause: General inequality on the full quadratic-form domain
evidence_or_owed: The excitation energy is defined on the form domain by the square root, and part (b) proves the inequality for every unit vector there under the form gap. A state of the number operator with finite mean and infinite second moment shows that the form domain is strictly larger.

clause: Fubini–Study form of the arbitrary input-state energy-gap estimate
evidence_or_owed: The distance is defined with the modulus of the overlap, measured from the ray of the ground, and the bound is displayed in that form.

clause: Reconstruction of a unit vector from ground fidelity, relative phase and normalized orthogonal component
evidence_or_owed: Displayed for fidelity strictly between zero and one, with the two boundary cases: no phase at zero, no conditional vector at one.

clause: Arbitrary normalized form-domain states on either side
evidence_or_owed: Part (a) is proved on the square-root form domain from the fact that the square root annihilates the ground. The text applies it to the input and to the output separately and says what the polar map does and does not transport.

clause: Arbitrary normalized finite-form-energy states on either side
evidence_or_owed: Part (b), with the gap stated as an inequality of forms on the form domain.

clause: Fubini–Study distance on the aligned graph ray space
draft_quote: The graph maps $G_\varphi$ of Section~\ref{sec:neutral-graphs-phase} are isometries as well
evidence_or_owed: The graph maps, the aligned one among them, are isometries, so the rays of two vectors, of their images and of their graph vectors have the same distances.

clause: Recovery of fidelity and Fubini–Study convergence from the ratio of components
evidence_or_owed: The fidelity is displayed as a function of the ratio of the two components, convergence to the ground ray is equivalent to that ratio tending to zero, and the statement is specialized to determinations acting on the ground.

evidence_or_owed: After the definition the text states that the excitation energy is nonnegative on the whole form domain, using only that the level is the bottom of the spectrum, and that uniqueness of the ground ray is a further assumption. Part (b) shows that a gap implies it.
